sentences.text: Helmand -LRB- -LSB- ˈhɛlmənd -RSB- ; Pashto/Dari : هلمند -RRB- , also known as Hillmand , and , in ancient times , as Hermand and Hethumand is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan , in the south of the country .	Pashto	Pashto language	Dari	Dari language	provinces	provinces of Afghanistan	Afghanistan	Afghanistan
It is the largest province by area , covering 58,584 km2 area .
The province contains 13 districts , encompassing over 1,000 villages , and roughly 879,500 settled people .	districts	Districts of Afghanistan
Lashkar Gah serves as the provincial capital .	Lashkar Gah	Lashkar Gah
Helmand was part of the Greater Kandahar region until made into a separate province by the Afghan government in the 20th century .	Kandahar	Kandahar	Afghan government	Politics of Afghanistan
The province has a domestic airport -LRB- Bost Airport -RRB- , in the city of Lashkar Gah and heavily used by NATO-led forces .	Lashkar Gah	Lashkar Gah	Bost Airport	Bost Airport	NATO	ISAF
The British Camp Bastion and U.S. Camp Leatherneck are a short distance southwest of Lashkar Gah .	Lashkar Gah	Lashkar Gah	Camp Bastion	Camp Bastion	Camp Leatherneck	Camp Leatherneck
The Helmand River flows through the mainly desert region of the province , providing water for irrigation .	Helmand River	Helmand River
The Kajaki Dam , which is one of Afghanistan 's major reservoirs , is located in the Kajaki district .	Afghanistan	Afghanistan	Kajaki Dam	Kajaki Dam	Kajaki district	Kajaki district
Helmand is believed to be one of the world 's largest opium-producing regions , responsible for around 42 % of the world 's total production .	opium	opium
This is believed to be more than the whole of Burma , which is the second largest producing nation after Afghanistan .	Afghanistan	Afghanistan	Burma	Burma
The region also produces tobacco , sugar beets , cotton , sesame , wheat , mung beans , maize , nuts , sunflowers , onions , potato , tomato , cauliflower , peanut , apricot , grape , and melon .
